title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-13

ai_review.summary: Super soundboard capture of the Oct 13 1968 Avalon show, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star and blistering Eleven with excellent vintage audio.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised across the board – Dark Star, Eleven, Death Don't Have No Mercy and the New Potato > Drums jam are described as near‑perfect moments of the band feeding off each other. The Charley Miller soundboard source delivers a clear, classic ’68 vibe, though a few listeners note a splice at New Potato and a slight pitch issue on one copy. Overall the show is high‑energy and the recording quality is solid enough to let those historic jams shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give five stars, highlighting exceptional musical moments and a generally clean soundboard source; only one minor technical complaint lowers the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Classic 1968 soundboard tape – crisp enough for most listeners. A possible splice between New Potato and Drums is mentioned, and one reviewer notes a pitch‑correction issue, but overall the audio is clear and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy second set that eclipses the first; tight transitions and powerful ensemble playing keep the momentum rolling, though the New Potato → Drums segue feels abrupt.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for masterful guitar tone on Dark Star and Death Don't Have No Mercy; described as "killin' it".
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for superb bass work, feeding off Jerry and the drummers; highlighted in Eleven.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers called fabulous overall, though the dedicated Drums segment was considered less compelling.
